ProgramUnit.Name: INITIALISE_WINDOWS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
BEGIN
 --:global.program_version := '3.01.00';
 --:global.program_version := '01';
 --:global.program_version := '02'; -- IM 8497
 -- :global.program_version := '03'; -- Removed Duplicate Objects
 
 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 :global.program_version := '01';

 
 :system.message_level := '10';
 :global.move_record:='N';
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.pb_retrieve');
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.location_id','E');
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.equip_date','E'); 
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.location_id');

 if :parameter.p_site_id is not null then
 :ctrl_blk_1.location_id:=:parameter.p_site_id;
 :ctrl_blk_1.equip_date:=to_date(:parameter.p_sch_date,'mmddrr');
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_day:=to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.equip_date,'DY');

 populate_machines(:ctrl_blk_1.equip_date);

 end if;

 set_window_property('win_donation',
 title,
 '[' || :banner.prog_name || ' ' || :global.program_version || '] ' ||
 'Assigned Equipment Information');

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_MACHINES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_machines(pl_date in date) IS
 Cursor pop_machine is select site_id,sch_date,donor_id,sch_from_time,sch_to_time,sp_code,
 last_name,first_name from donor_schedule where 
 site_id=nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.location_id,site_id) and
 sch_date >= nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.equip_date,sysdate) and sp_code is not null;

 v_start_time varchar2(10);
 v_end_time varchar2(10);
 v_desc varchar2(50);
 v_name varchar2(70);

BEGIN 
 go_block('equipment_details');
 clear_block;
 first_record;
 For r in pop_machine loop
 create_record; 
 v_start_time:=to_char(r.sch_from_time,'hh24:mi');
 v_end_time:=to_char(r.sch_to_time,'hh24:mi');
 
 Begin 
 select description into v_desc from fixed_site_attributes where
 site_id=r.site_id and sp_code=r.sp_code;
 exception 
 When others then
 v_desc:='Unknown';
 end;

 Begin 
 select initcap(location_name) into :equipment_details.location_name from locations where
 location_id=r.site_id ;
 exception 
 When others then
 message(sqlerrm);pause;
 :equipment_details.location_name:='Unknown';
 end;

 :equipment_details.location_id :=r.site_id;
 :equipment_details.used_date :=r.sch_date;
 :equipment_details.equip_code :=r.sp_code;
 :equipment_details.equip_des :=Initcap(v_desc);
 :equipment_details.start_time :=v_start_time;
 :equipment_details.end_time :=v_end_time;
 :equipment_details.donor_id :=r.donor_id;
 :equipment_details.donor_name :=substr(r.first_name,1,1)||'. '||initcap(r.last_name);
 End loop;
 first_record;

 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.location_id','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.equip_date','D');
END;

 if v_count > 0 then 
 null;

END;
